title: Hotbar Extensions
description: adds hotbar extensions that show health of armor, and how many blocks you have left in your inventory of the currently held block.
body:
![hotbar extensions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/560f47b161035f1de8bbdd9ab942ba6d6db0ae4a.png)

Adds extensions to the hotbar that allows you to see your armor, and how many blocks you have left in your inventory. 

![customizable positions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7103c9a4dda4aa07a79de6047bb83bbb48b6e393.png)

you can also customize where everything is, you can shift click in the mods config using a mod like mod menu on fabric, and select multiple slots, and drag them around to how you want it. 

![drag menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/72918b212cc41f63fad35d835a93f001ec9197c4_0.webp)
